export default "## Privacy Policy\n\n_Last Updated: September 24, 2025_\n\nPatriot Grassroots (\"we,\" \"us,\" or \"our\") operates the Patriot app (the \"App\" or \"Services\").\nWe are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly.\nThis Privacy Policy describes the types of personal information we collect through the App, how we use and disclose it, and your choices and rights regarding your information.\nThis policy applies to all users of the App, including canvassers who use it for fieldwork.\n\nBy downloading, installing, or using the App, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.\n**If you do not agree, please do not use the App.**\n\"Personal Information\" refers to any information that identifies or relates to an identifiable individual.\n\n### 1. NOTICE AT COLLECTION OF PERSONAL INFORMATION\n\n#### A. Types of Personal Information We Collect\n\nWe collect the following categories of personal information:\n\n- Identifiers: Full legal name, government identifiers required for payroll and background checks, profile photograph.\n- Financial and Employment Information: Payroll details.\n- Geolocation Data: GPS locations, Bluetooth data, and motion data from the device.\n- Audio Data: Brief live audio from the canvasser's voice.\n- Voter-Related Information: Names and residential addresses from petition images (indirectly collected via uploads) - this is used for signature verification purposes only.\n\n#### B. Business and Commercial Purposes\n\nWe collect personal information for the following purposes:\n\n- To onboard canvassers, process payments, and administer employment.\n- To verify fieldwork, track shifts, and sync with canvassing tools.\n- To validate signatures in real time using petition images and live audio.\n- To comply with legal obligations, such as tax reporting and background checks.\n- To improve App performance and ensure security.\n- To communicate with users and provide support.\n\n#### C. Retention\n\nWe retain canvasser personal information (e.g., identifiers, financial data, profile photos) as long as legally required to comply with payroll, tax, and legal requirements.\nVoter-related information (names, addresses) is deleted immediately after validation.\nWe do not store any audio data at all, as it is processed in real-time without recording or memory storage—a key feature of our technology.\nWe may retain anonymized or aggregated daily canvasser data for analytical purposes.\n\n### 2. PERSONAL INFORMATION WE COLLECT\n\n#### A. Information You Provide\n\nWe collect information you voluntarily provide during registration, onboarding, or use of the App, such as:\n\n- Account creation: Full legal name, email, phone number, username, and password.\n- Onboarding: Government identifiers required for payroll and background checks, payroll details, and profile photograph.\n- Fieldwork uploads: Petition images containing voter names and addresses.\n\n#### B. Information We Automatically Collect\n\nWhen you use the App, we automatically collect:\n\n- Device and usage data: Device type, operating system, IP address, session duration, and interaction patterns.\n- Location data: GPS locations, Bluetooth data, and motion data from the device to verify fieldwork and sync devices.\n- Audio data: Brief microphone access during signature validation to confirm canvasser presence (your voice only; no recording or storage).\n- We request permissions for location, background activity, Bluetooth, and microphone as needed for App functionality.\n\n#### C. Information We Receive from Third Parties\n\nWe may receive information from:\n\n- Third-party canvassing apps: Location data and fieldwork metrics exported to our App.\n- Background check providers: Verification results based on provided identifiers.\n- Payment processors (e.g., Branch): Confirmation of payout setup (we do not receive payment card details).\n\n#### D. Combination of Information\n\nWe may combine information from these sources to provide Services, validate data, and improve functionality, as described in this policy.\n\n### 3. HOW WE DISCLOSE YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION\n\nWe disclose personal information only as necessary for the purposes described above. Disclosures may include:\n\n- To service providers for auditing, security, debugging, and performance monitoring.\n- To background check vendors: Limited identifiers for verification; data deleted after use.\n- To payment processors (e.g., Branch): Payout triggers only; no identifiers or sensitive details shared.\n- To government authorities or as required by law, such as for legal compliance, subpoenas, or to protect rights and safety.\n- In the event of a business transfer, such as a merger or acquisition.\n  We do not sell personal information. Disclosures to service providers are governed by contracts requiring confidentiality and data protection.\n\nWe never share or sell mobile phone numbers, SMS opt-in status, or text-messaging consent with\nthird parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.\n\n### 4. YOUR PRIVACY CHOICES AND RIGHTS\n\n#### A. Unsubscribing from Marketing Communications\n\nIf we send marketing emails, you can opt out by following the instructions in the email or contacting us.\n\n#### B. Privacy Rights and Requests\n\nDepending on your location, you may have rights such as:\n\n- Right to Know: Access details about the personal information we collect, use, or disclose.\n- Right to Portability: Receive your data in a portable format.\n- Right to Delete: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal retention requirements).\n- Right to Correct: Update inaccurate information.\n- Right to Opt Out: Opt out of any sale or sharing (though we do not sell data).\n  Submit requests to privacy@patriotgrassroots.com. We will verify your identity and respond within 30-45 days, as required by law (e.g., CCPA for California residents).\n\n#### C. Agent Requests\n\nYou may use an authorized agent to submit rights requests, provided we can verify the agent's authority and your identity.\n\n#### D. Right to Appeal\n\nIf we deny a request, you may appeal by contacting us at privacy@patriotgrassroots.com, and we will review and respond promptly.\n\n### 5. EXTERNAL LINKS\n\nThe App may integrate or link to third-party services (e.g., Branch for payments).\nThese third parties have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their practices.\nReview their policies before providing information.\n\n### 6. DATA SECURITY\n\nWe implement robust physical, technical, organizational, and administrative measures to protect personal information, including encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular audits.\nWe regularly review and update our safeguards to align with the latest best security practices.\nHowever, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.\nYou are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and securing your device.\n\n### 7. REVISIONS TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY\n\nWe may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements.\nWe will notify you of material changes via in-App notice, email, or other means.\nYour continued use of the App after updates constitutes acceptance.\nWe encourage you to review this policy periodically.\n\n### 8. HOW TO CONTACT US\n\nIf you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:\nprivacy@patriotgrassroots.com\n"
